g.text: Joint adaptation and selection: measured scoped pilots
A–B: same endpoint accuracy caps, different achieved errors; timing is diagnostic. C: direct pool startup is charged once; drift phase intentionally keeps a stale epoch.
D: derivative-free original-target stage residuals; serial emulation of correction rounds, not measured parallel speedup. Scalar and interval evaluation counts have different unit costs.
